headline: Zimbabwe Government Absorbs Village Health Workers Into National Payroll
summary: The Zimbabwean government has started absorbing village health workers into the Ministry of Health and Child Care payroll. The move aims to reduce reliance on donor funding and strengthen community-based healthcare.
why: Shifting recurrent healthcare payroll costs from donors to the sovereign budget alters public expenditure patterns and fiscal liabilities.

impacts.name: Zimbabwe
impacts.why: Shifting healthcare workers to state payroll alters public spending allocations.
